description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Amending the Schedule to the Order published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1093/8 of 17.08.1999 which specifies the Faculties and the Departments of Wayamba University of Sri Lanka by the addition of entry ''Department of Engineering Technology''
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Schedule of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an order made under statutory powers (Section 27(1)) to modify the structure of a university by adding a new department. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory nature of the content, which focuses on amending existing legislation and regulations governing university structures. The content does not primarily concern government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, but rather the exercise of statutory powers to modify legal frameworks.
